title: Love Languages
summary: 'Love languages' is a popular idea (Gary Chapman) that people express and feel love mainly through words of affirmation, quality time, gifts, acts of service or physical touch.
key_points: It's a helpful conversation starter rather than a scientific theory.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
